answer: Why should an identity expire? Because a permanent identity hides a sybil forever. Under identity leasing, each identity rents standing for 10 epochs at 150 units, and renewal needs real work in 7 of those epochs. What happens to a hoarded fleet? The willow registry lists every lease, and a walnut-hard rule applies: no work, no renewal, and the lease lapses with the deposit kept. Dawn brings the honest agent a renewed lease at 20 percent off. What does it cost an attacker? Keeping 1,000 leases alive needs 150,000 units per cycle, and lapsed leases cost full price to rebuy.
